quest.title: Gathering of Stars
quest.description: Farbal from Rtawahist seems to be busy with something...

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: I hope everyone will enjoy this little gadget...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's there to play over here?

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: You're... the Traveler, aren't you? I'm Farbal, from Rtawahist.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: Um, I don't suppose you know what it is we study here, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh. Well, I think it was...

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: We study the stars... though that's not a very precise way of putting it. We do have a lot of specializations within the Darshan itself.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, a lot of things about our research wouldn't make much sense to the average person if we just explained it as-is... In fact, the chances of them even being interested are slim.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: And I was concerned that setting up an astrology booth would just end in the involved students getting into academic discussions and not manning the stall.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: As such, after much discussion, we decided on a middle-of-the-road option.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: See this special astrolabe? Many stars have been placed on it, and what you need to do is arrange them into a specified image.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: These images will not be particularly complicated, and they will not involve any ongoing and as-yet-unresolved academic disputes.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: Ahem... So, uh... A simple, fun, and definitely not divisive pictorial puzzle!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You strike me as being really nervous.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: Well, this game does have to do with the stars, after all. Some of our students get the sweats the moment they hear that word.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: You don't know how many people I had to tell that this is just a toy and has nothing to do with academic research...

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: Never mind that. If you're interested, feel free to give it a go.

choices.text: I'd like to give this a try.

response.speaker: Farbal
response.text: Sure. The astrolabe is over here.

choices.text: I've got other matters to attend to at the moment.

response.speaker: Farbal
response.text: Well, I'll be here at the booth throughout the Gala. If you're of a mind to play, just hit me up.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: (This really is just a toy! I'm not taking this job next time, never mind what anyone else says... *sigh*)
